verdict.rationale: Crossplane is fundamentally a Kubernetes-native control plane whose entire interaction model is the declarative API (CRDs/YAML) rather than a separate UI — docs explicitly describe exposing 'declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on' and building platforms via machine-readable, auditable APIs, meaning there is no UI-only capability gap by design. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation/comparison against any optional UI (e.g., Upbound console) showing full feature parity, and independent hands-on verification of API completeness.
